description: Check a power cable against a standard's nominal rules: a designation with size and voltage, a designer design, or the construction a maker's datasheet or tender offer states (layers with nominal and minimum thicknesses, screen and armour data). Rule sets: IEC 60502-1 / -2, IEC 60228, HD 603 3-G / 5-G, HD 620 10-J / M / D / C / K, BS 5467, BS 6724, BS 7846, BS 6622, IS 694, IS 1554-1 / -2, IS 7098-1 / -2, IS 8130, or "auto" for the standards the cable claims. Every rule with required, found, pass / fail / not checkable and its source (standard, edition, clause or table, page, how firmly seen). Deterministic, no LLM. A check against nominal rules, not a certificate or a type test.

construction.description: Instead of a designation: the construction as a datasheet states it: {name, voltage: "12/20", cores, conductor: {metal, section, shape, class, resistance, diameter}, core: [{kind, material, nominal, minimum}], common: [...], overallDiameter, standards: [...]}. Layers inside out.

design.description: Instead of a designation: a thecablecode design v1 (the design field of a design_cable answer).

designation.description: A power cable designation with its size and voltage, e.g. "NA2XS(F)2Y 1x240/25 12/20 kV", "AXCLJ-TT 3x95/25 12/20 kV", "NYY-J 4x16".

standard.description: "auto" (default: the standards the input claims) or rule sets, comma separated, at most 4: iec-60502-1-2004, iec-60502-2-2014, iec-60228-2004, hd-603-3-g, hd-603-5-g, hd-620-10-j, hd-620-10-m, hd-620-10-d, hd-620-10-c, hd-620-10-k, bs-5467, bs-6724, bs-7846, bs-6622, is-694, is-1554-1, is-1554-2, is-7098-1, is-7098-2, is-8130-2013. Printed names work too ("IEC 60502-2", "HD 620 10-J").

name: check_cable
title: Check a power cable against a standard
